description: Figure 5 presents the distribution of deceived conversations as a percentage across varying degrees of ambiguity, represented by the categories “Academic Collaboration,” “Academic Funding,” “Journalism,” and “Recruitment.” The chart consists of four slices. The “Academic Collaboration” slice is red and represents approximately 0.72% of the total. The “Academic Funding” slice is orange and represents approximately 0.70%. The “Journalism” slice is green and represents approximately 0.69%. Finally, the “Recruitment” slice is blue and represents approximately 0.67%. The chart includes a legend identifying each category with its corresponding color. The slices are visually ordered from largest to smallest, based on the percentage represented. Percentage labels are included directly within each slice.
